g.text: CD-2 — Diagnostic Orchestration, RAG and LLM
Sanitized evidence + authorized context + RAG with provenance
Wraps probable_cause text; no additional taxonomy
Associates recommendations; evidence and sources by logical ID
append-only; current = highest version per incident
ACL; Azure response converted to internal types
recommendation_service / Java / Spring Boot / status: proposed
Logical CQRS / same PostgreSQL instance / dependencies through interfaces
DiagnosticOutputComposer realizes diagnostic_output_component within this figure.
Only sanitized evidence, authorized context and RAG knowledge reach the gateway.
Each diagnostic snapshot is immutable; DIAGNOSIS_READY requires a probable cause and a timestamp.
Recommendations and links are inserted with the snapshot; logical IDs connect contexts.
